body.spicy: Your instinct is to redo it to a standard nobody asked for. Often the right call. Occasionally you're polishing something that needed to be sent.
body.boardroom: Your instinct is to raise the standard and redo the work. Frequently correct. Occasionally you refine something that simply needed to be sent.

body.spicy: You turn outward. Very useful in a team, and a spectacular way to avoid your own inbox.
body.boardroom: You turn outward and support others. Genuinely valuable, and occasionally a way of deferring your own work.

body.spicy: You make it presentable fast. Brilliant under pressure. Risky when presentable and correct part ways.
body.boardroom: You move quickly to something presentable. Strong under pressure, provided presentable and correct stay aligned.

body.spicy: You process before you act. That's real information — as long as the processing has an exit.
body.boardroom: You process before acting. That processing carries real information, provided it concludes.

body.spicy: You research. Excellent instinct, right up until reading becomes the thing you do instead of the task.
body.boardroom: You research first. An excellent instinct, until reading substitutes for the task.

body.spicy: You verify before committing. Saves rework. Also the easiest way to hand your judgement to someone else.
body.boardroom: You verify before committing. This prevents rework, but can transfer your judgement to others.

body.spicy: You move to something you can win at. Great for morale, terrible for the thing you moved away from.
body.boardroom: You redirect towards work you can progress. Useful for momentum, unhelpful for the original problem.

body.spicy: You grab the wheel. Things do get fixed. People also stop telling you things.
body.boardroom: You take control. Problems get resolved, though others may stop raising them with you.

body.spicy: You let it settle. Sometimes genuinely wise. Sometimes it's a decision made by not deciding.
body.boardroom: You allow time to resolve it. Sometimes wise, sometimes a decision taken by default.
